latin: Frustra Palemonem et Leucotheam adibit, qui Nereum non attraxerit, nec Nereum attrahet qui circa primariam animalem trinitatem operatus non fuerit.
translation: He who has not drawn Nereus to himself will approach Palaemon and Leucothea in vain, and he will not draw Nereus to himself who has not worked upon the primary trinity of the soul.
